The '''Acquisition Division''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was responsible for taking [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to become [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Jedi recruiter]]s of the Acquisition Division dealt closely with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in their pursuit of new members. On all Republic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], all newborns were subject to mandatory blood-testing to detect the concentration of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|Midi-chlorians]] in a sample. If results were returned with a high percentage, the sample was forwarded to the Temple on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for recording in the Division's database, known as the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]].<ref name="TJP" />

Recruiters were tasked with using the information in the Kyber crystal to seek out and recruit those infants who showed potential, taking them from their families or guardians. While the Jedi did seek permission from the birth parents as to whether the child might be raised in the Order, the Jedi were given legal authority to take custody of any and all Force-sensitives. If a potential Force-user was identified in later stages of development, a positive test result might not have been definitive in judging their potential to become a Jedi. Special equipment was used in testing their perception and preternatural abilities, such as the [[Jedi testing screen/Legends|testing screen]].<ref name="TJP" />

Recruiter [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] was responsible for the recruitment of future [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council member]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] at the late age of four,<ref name="SWR">{{StoryCite|series=Star Wars (1998)|srtext=''Star Wars'' (1998)|issue1=4|issue2=6|story=Vow of Justice}}</ref> while the nine-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was discovered by non-Recruiter [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on distant [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Roan Shryne]], discovered by a recruiter and taken to the Temple at the age of three, was later offered a post in the Acquisition Division, but turned it down.<ref name="DL" />
